library(readxl)

## 1. Overview

This report cross-checks the Excel driver-based FP&A forecast (FY2026-27 to FY2030-31) against an independently fitted **Prophet** trend model built on the same six years of actuals (FY2020-21 to FY2025-26), for Revenue, EBITDA, and PAT across all five companies. Because Prophet is run on only six annual points, seasonality is switched off and changepoint flexibility is kept conservative — Prophet is functioning here as a **robust trend-validation check**, not a full seasonal forecast.

```{r load-data}
raw <- read_excel("C:/Users/nkr71/Downloads/IIP/Project_1.xlsx", sheet = "Financial Modeling (2)", skip = 1)

data <- raw %>%
  select(Company, `Financial Year`, `Revenue (Turnover)`, EBITDA, PAT) %>%
  rename(Revenue = `Revenue (Turnover)`) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Company))

fy_to_date <- function(fy) {
  start_yr <- as.integer(substr(fy, 3, 6))
  as.Date(paste0(start_yr + 1, "-03-31"))
}

data <- data %>% mutate(ds = fy_to_date(`Financial Year`))

actual_years   <- paste0("FY", 2020:2025, "-", sprintf("%02d", (21:26) %% 100))
forecast_years <- paste0("FY", 2026:2030, "-", sprintf("%02d", (27:31) %% 100))

actuals   <- data %>% filter(`Financial Year` %in% actual_years)
driver_fc <- data %>% filter(`Financial Year` %in% forecast_years) %>%
  rename(Revenue_Driver = Revenue, EBITDA_Driver = EBITDA, PAT_Driver = PAT) %>%
  select(Company, `Financial Year`, ds, Revenue_Driver, EBITDA_Driver, PAT_Driver)

companies <- unique(actuals$Company)
metrics   <- c("Revenue", "EBITDA", "PAT")
```

```{r fit-functions}
fit_prophet_model <- function(df) {
  prophet(
    df, growth = "linear",
    yearly.seasonality = FALSE, weekly.seasonality = FALSE, daily.seasonality = FALSE,
    n.changepoints = 2, changepoint.prior.scale = 0.05, interval.width = 0.80
  )
}

run_prophet <- function(company, metric) {
  tryCatch({
    df <- actuals %>% filter(Company == company) %>% transmute(ds = ds, y = .data[[metric]])
    m <- fit_prophet_model(df)
    future <- make_future_dataframe(m, periods = 5, freq = "year")
    fcst <- predict(m, future)
    fcst %>% mutate(ds = as.Date(ds)) %>% filter(ds > max(df$ds)) %>%
      transmute(Company = company, Metric = metric, ds,
                Prophet_Forecast = yhat, Prophet_Lower = yhat_lower, Prophet_Upper = yhat_upper)
  }, error = function(e) {
    tibble(Company = company, Metric = metric, ds = as.Date(NA),
           Prophet_Forecast = NA, Prophet_Lower = NA, Prophet_Upper = NA)
  })
}

run_loocv <- function(company, metric) {
  df <- actuals %>% filter(Company == company) %>%
    transmute(ds = ds, y = .data[[metric]]) %>% arrange(ds)
  preds <- map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(df)), function(i) {
    tryCatch({
      train <- df[-i, ]
      m <- fit_prophet_model(train)
      fc <- predict(m, df[i, "ds", drop = FALSE])
      tibble(ds = df$ds[i], actual = df$y[i], predicted = fc$yhat)
    }, error = function(e) tibble(ds = df$ds[i], actual = df$y[i], predicted = NA))
  })
  tibble(Company = company, Metric = metric,
         MAPE_pct = round(mean(abs((preds$actual - preds$predicted) / preds$actual), na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 2),
         RMSE = round(sqrt(mean((preds$actual - preds$predicted)^2, na.rm = TRUE)), 1))
}
```

```{r run-models, include=FALSE}
results <- map_dfr(companies, function(co) map_dfr(metrics, function(me) run_prophet(co, me)))
accuracy_summary <- map_dfr(companies, function(co) map_dfr(metrics, function(me) run_loocv(co, me)))

comparison <- results %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Metric, values_from = c(Prophet_Forecast, Prophet_Lower, Prophet_Upper)) %>%
  left_join(driver_fc, by = c("Company", "ds")) %>%
  mutate(
    Var_Revenue_pct = round((Prophet_Forecast_Revenue - Revenue_Driver) / Revenue_Driver * 100, 2),
    Var_EBITDA_pct  = round((Prophet_Forecast_EBITDA  - EBITDA_Driver)  / EBITDA_Driver  * 100, 2),
    Var_PAT_pct     = round((Prophet_Forecast_PAT     - PAT_Driver)     / PAT_Driver     * 100, 2),
    Flag_Revenue = ifelse(abs(Var_Revenue_pct) > 15, "REVIEW", ""),
    Flag_EBITDA  = ifelse(abs(Var_EBITDA_pct)  > 15, "REVIEW", ""),
    Flag_PAT     = ifelse(abs(Var_PAT_pct)     > 15, "REVIEW", "")
  ) %>%
  select(Company, `Financial Year`, ds,
         Revenue_Driver, Prophet_Forecast_Revenue, Var_Revenue_pct, Flag_Revenue,
         EBITDA_Driver, Prophet_Forecast_EBITDA, Var_EBITDA_pct, Flag_EBITDA,
         PAT_Driver, Prophet_Forecast_PAT, Var_PAT_pct, Flag_PAT) %>%
  arrange(Company, ds)

company_summary <- comparison %>%
  group_by(Company) %>%
  summarise(
    Avg_Abs_Variance_pct = round(mean(abs(c(Var_Revenue_pct, Var_EBITDA_pct, Var_PAT_pct)), na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    Max_Abs_Variance_pct = round(max(abs(c(Var_Revenue_pct, Var_EBITDA_pct, Var_PAT_pct)), na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    Flags_Raised = sum(Flag_Revenue == "REVIEW", Flag_EBITDA == "REVIEW", Flag_PAT == "REVIEW")
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Avg_Abs_Variance_pct))
```

## 2. Prophet In-Sample Accuracy (Leave-One-Out CV)

With only six annual points per series there is no genuine holdout period, so accuracy is checked by leave-one-out cross-validation: fit on five years, predict the excluded year, repeat for all six. Lower MAPE/RMSE indicates a more reliable trend fit for that company/metric.

```{r accuracy-table}
datatable(accuracy_summary, options = list(pageLength = 15, dom = 't'), rownames = FALSE) %>%
  formatStyle('MAPE_pct', backgroundColor = styleInterval(c(5, 10), c('#d4edda', '#fff3cd', '#f8d7da')))
```

## 3. Company-Level Divergence Summary

Ranked by average absolute variance between the Prophet cross-check and the Excel driver-based forecast, across Revenue, EBITDA and PAT.

```{r summary-table}
kable(company_summary, format = "html", caption = "Higher values indicate greater divergence between the two forecasting methods") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE) %>%
  row_spec(which(company_summary$Flags_Raised > 0), background = "#fff3cd")
```

## 4. Full Forecast Comparison Table

Driver-based (Excel) vs Prophet forecast, FY2026-27 to FY2030-31. Rows flagged **REVIEW** where the two methods diverge by more than 15%.

```{r comparison-table}
datatable(comparison, options = list(pageLength = 10, scrollX = TRUE), rownames = FALSE) %>%
  formatStyle('Flag_Revenue', backgroundColor = styleEqual("REVIEW", "#f8d7da")) %>%
  formatStyle('Flag_EBITDA',  backgroundColor = styleEqual("REVIEW", "#f8d7da")) %>%
  formatStyle('Flag_PAT',     backgroundColor = styleEqual("REVIEW", "#f8d7da"))
```

## 5. Forecast Charts — Actual vs Driver-Based vs Prophet

```{r plots, results='asis'}
for (co in companies) {
  cat("###", co, "\n\n")
  for (me in metrics) {
    act <- actuals %>% filter(Company == co) %>% transmute(ds, value = .data[[me]], series = "Actual")
    driver_col <- paste0(me, "_Driver")
    drv <- driver_fc %>% filter(Company == co) %>%
      transmute(ds, value = .data[[driver_col]], series = "Driver-based (Excel)")
    proph <- results %>% filter(Company == co, Metric == me) %>%
      transmute(ds, value = Prophet_Forecast, series = "Prophet")
    plot_df <- bind_rows(act, drv, proph)

    p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = ds, y = value, color = series, linetype = series)) +
      geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) + geom_point(size = 1.8) +
      labs(title = paste(me), x = NULL, y = me, color = NULL, linetype = NULL) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 11) + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
    print(p)
    cat("\n\n")
  }
}
```
